body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a 3-unit line within 6 units. Compare this Action against each creature in the line; on a success, deal 1 Force damage and move it 1 unit.

surges.html: One affected creature gains +1 die on its next Action before your next turn.
Ignore 1 Defense granted by a magical effect for this spell.

rider.title: AIR THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread before resolving a future Magecraft Action that moves a creature to move one affected creature 1 additional unit.
